items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So he was getting ready to leave town and he liked my little work.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he's getting ready to leave. His wife was a dancer and she worked with, I can't remember who. So he was getting ready to leave town and he liked my little work. So we got to talking and he said, "Well, how would you like to make a little tour with us?" I said, "Sound fine to me. My levee is closed." Cecil Scott, we'd had gone from the Congo Roof to another little ballroom. And the ballroom was -- some little thing happened there. We'd bring the shows on a Thursday night from the Booker T. Washington…
